definitions.explanation: The act of closing off or blocking access to an area, border, account, or system to prevent entry, exit, or use.

examples.japanese: {道路|どうろ}が{封鎖|ふうさ}された。
{警察|けいさつ}が{現場|げんば}{周辺|しゅうへん}を{封鎖|ふうさ}している。
examples.english: The police have sealed off the area around the scene.

examples.japanese: {感染症|かんせんしょう}の{拡大|かくだい}を{防|ふせ}ぐため、{都市|とし}が{封鎖|ふうさ}された。
examples.english: The city was locked down to prevent the spread of the infection.

notes: Used as both a noun and a suru-verb ({封鎖|ふうさ}する). Common collocations include {道路|どうろ}{封鎖|ふうさ} (road blockade), {国境|こっきょう}{封鎖|ふうさ} (border closure), {口座|こうざ}{封鎖|ふうさ} (account freeze), and {都市|とし}{封鎖|ふうさ} (city lockdown). The word gained wider usage during pandemic-related discussions as the Japanese equivalent of lockdown, though ロックダウン is also used.
